# WarmMemo 暖備

> WarmMemo is a Traditional Chinese web application for organizing digital obituaries, memorial pages, service packages, notifications, and order delivery workflows.

Canonical site: https://leo0331.github.io/warmmemo/
Primary language: Traditional Chinese (zh-TW)
Source repository: https://github.com/leo0331/warmmemo

## What WarmMemo does

- Helps families draft and share digital obituary content.
- Lets users prepare memorial-page drafts and intentionally publish shareable pages.
- Provides service-package comparison and authenticated order-status tracking.
- Gives authorized service teams an administrative workflow from proposal review through delivery scheduling.

## Important boundaries

- WarmMemo is a content and workflow tool, not medical, legal, religious, or emergency advice.
- Actual service items depend on the partner and region.
- Payment completion may require manual verification by an administrator.
- Private drafts and orders require authentication. Individual memorial URLs are intentionally excluded from the sitemap.
